structured.answer: With 750 ₪ a month for 15 years and nothing at the start, the page says I'd have paid in 135,000 ₪ and would be left with about 179,889 ₪ "בכסף של היום", after fees and tax, if prices go up 2% a year. It puts the money in a פסגות ניירות ערך account with the ילין לפידות S&P 500 fund. Before I sign anything I'd ask you or the bank.

stuck.where: The result box next to the deposits
stuck.why: It says 'בכסף של היום' but doesn't say which inflation rate. I had to press the 'אינפלציה' button to find it was 2%.
I don't know what 'קרן מחקה', 'עסקת החלף' or 'צוברת' mean, so I can't tell what the fund is.

used: The three input boxes: סכום היום, הפקדה חודשית, שנים
הבחירה שלכם · הזול 179,889 ₪ ... אחרי דמי ניהול ומס, בכסף של היום
The account card: פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ, 2,604 ₪ over 15 years
The fund card: ילין לפידות קרן מחקה S&P 500 (4D)
skimmed: The colour legend under the bars
The 'כל הקרנות על מדד S&P 500' tags
unsure_meaning: 'אם הדולר לא זז מול השקל': so what happens if it does?
not_found: The inflation rate written next to the result, without opening a popup
A plain sentence saying this can lose money, compared with a bank deposit

findings.what: The whole page is white and grey on black. The small grey lines were hard to read even enlarged.
The page opens with English letters and an index. Someone like me would leave on the first screen.
The 2% inflation is hidden behind a button. It should be written next to the result.
The 7% yearly growth is presented as a plain number. Nothing says it isn't guaranteed or that you can lose money.
The cost bar's colours are hard to tell apart, and the small numbers on it are tiny.
Many unexplained terms on the fund card (קרן מחקה, נאמן, עסקת החלף).
I typed 750, but the slider shows 800. That's confusing.
